# cloudflare-postgres (pgcf)

> Open-source serverless PostgreSQL. A Cloudflare control plane (API Worker, Edge Worker, Durable Objects) places real PostgreSQL 18 on your own VPS nodes. Databases sleep when idle and wake on connect. Used by ohmyho.st.

Start here when you integrate pgcf or when you see a pgcf error.

- [Errors](https://github.com/amerged-org/cloudflare-postgres/blob/main/docs/errors.md): every API error code, `details.reason`, validation field list and connection refusal with cause, fix and whether a retry helps. Read this first for any error.
- [Integrator handover](https://github.com/amerged-org/cloudflare-postgres/blob/main/docs/operations/integrator-handover.md): the REST API, connecting, limits, metering, recovery. Long; use its table of contents. Appendix A is the error reference.
- [README](https://github.com/amerged-org/cloudflare-postgres/blob/main/README.md): stack, architecture and the TypeScript client (`PgcfClient`).
- [Operator installation](https://github.com/amerged-org/cloudflare-postgres/blob/main/docs/operations/operator-installation.md): self-hosting. Only for the operator of an installation.

Facts that answer most questions:

- REST under `/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; `GET /v1/openapi.json` is the contract. Mutations need an `Idempotency-Key`.
- An error body is `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"?}}`; `details.reason` is the stable cause, `details.fields` lists each field a validation refused, `Retry-After` says when a retry can help.
- A database connection refusal is a PostgreSQL error; its message ends with `(pgcf: <reason>)` where the Edge decided it. A wrong password, an unknown role and an unknown database are one `28P01` answer by design.
- `pgcf connect --endpoint wss://<host> --database <id> --user <role>` opens a local loopback port for psql and migration tools.
